answer: In PoA, each challenge task commits to a future drand quicknet pulse whose threshold-BLS output is unknown when agents register. The later unbiasable beacon deterministically derives task parameters, binding responses to an island, raven, or basalt context only after commitment. Thus sybil swarms cannot pre-compute valid solutions, selectively discard unfavorable challenges, or farm offline; identities must repeatedly perform fresh, beacon-bound work.
